claims.claim: Add an image processing driver for the Qualcomm Offline Processing Engine (OPE). OPE is a memory-to-memory ISP block that converts raw Bayer frames to YUV, performing white balance, demosaic, chroma enhancement, color correction and downscaling. The hardware architecture consists of Fetch Engines and Write Engines, connected through intermediate pipeline modules for pix processing.
